name: The Engineering Firm
description: Each engineer at the firm leads a different project in a different discipline. Work out who's building what.
clues: Either Laser goes with Satellite or Edison goes with Satellite.
Bridge goes with neither Diesel nor Blowtorch.
Either Watt goes with Reactor, or Skyscraper goes with Laser — but not both.
Either Diesel goes with Blowtorch, or Tesla goes with Satellite — but not both.
Either Otis goes with Dam, or Tesla goes with Oscilloscope — but not both.
Either Blowtorch goes with Bridge or Skyscraper goes with Watt.
Caliper goes with at least one of Diesel or Dam.
